title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU Global Gateway Energy Transition Investment and Policy Support Programme in Cambodia

description.narrative: Cambodia¿s rapidly growing, export¿oriented economy has led to a steep rise in electricity demand, while the power system remains heavily dependent on imported coal and large hydropower, exposure to fuel¿price and supply¿chain shocks, and increased climate vulnerability in one of the most climate¿exposed countries in the world. Cambodia also has one of the highest retail electricity prices in the region. At the same time, Cambodia has committed, under its Long¿Term Strategy for Carbon Neutrality, NDC 3.0, the Power Development Plan 2022¿2040, and the National Energy Efficiency Policy 2022¿2030, to a profound transformation of its power mix, including a substantial increase in renewable energy, improved grid performance and enhanced energy efficiency, as well as deeper integration into the ASEAN Power Grid. This action will support these ambitions, through a Technical Assistance and two twinning contracts, by helping Cambodia move towards a more sustainable, inclusive and climate¿neutral development model, promoting European quality investments, and ultimately strengthening the country¿s integration into ASEAN. The action fully aligns with the EU Global Gateway Strategy, the EU Indo¿Pacific Strategy, and the EU¿Cambodia Multi¿annual Indicative Programme 2021¿2027 priorities on green growth, decent jobs and good governance. The Overall Objective of the action is to support Cambodia¿s sustainable, inclusive and climate¿neutral growth through a 360-degree approach, ultimately enhancing its integration in ASEAN. The Specific Objective is to advance policy reforms and Global Gateway investments for energy transition, supporting the ASEAN Power Grid. The action comprises two mutually reinforcing outputs.Output 1 (EUR 5.85 M): a strengthened energy transition framework, focusing on more coherent, transparent and predictable policies, regulations and institutional capacities for renewable energy, energy efficiency, power¿sector development, and green investment. It will be implemented through two Twinning grants, with the Ministry of Mines and Energy and with the Ministry of Economy and Finance, aimed at strengthening Cambodia¿s energy policy, regulatory and institutional framework, including public financial management aspects related to green investments, and to integrate cross¿cutting priorities such as gender equality, social inclusion, environmental safeguards, and a human¿rights¿based approach.Output 2 (EUR 5.85 M): a Global Gateway investments pipeline, focusing on the development and structuring of investment opportunities in Cambodia¿s energy sector that meet Global Gateway criteria and can be financed by Team Europe and other partners. It will be implemented through targeted technical assistance aimed at identifying, preparing, and structuring Global Gateway investment opportunities in renewable electricity generation, storage (including pumped¿hydro), grid modernisation and energy efficiency, among others.
